final_message:
If you complete the revised plan, you’re projected to meet 2 of 5 targets by the cells exam on 2027-03-08T09:00:00-05:00. I cleared the blocks that conflicted with your shifts or fell after the exam.

I kept two 40-minute sessions on plant and animal cell organelles, starting Friday at 2027-03-05T18:30:00-05:00 and Saturday at 2027-03-06T10:00:00-05:00. Together they bring organelles to 70.5% against a 70% target. Tuesday’s practice already puts protein processing and transport by the ER and Golgi at 65%, above its 60% target.

Three skills are projected to fall short under this plan:

- Fluid mosaic model — 25.4% against a 65% target
- Diffusion and osmosis — 33.1% against a 65% target
- Pumps and energy-dependent transport — 32.8% against a 60% target
